column3: “Everyone” combines the third-person them with the following each.
“The people” supplies the subject of wandering; idols generalizes teraphim.
“Leaders” interprets the male goats; punish specifies visit.
“Judah” specifies the initial him; tent specifies the peg.
“The enemy” supplies the object of trampling.
“To gather” replaces and I will gather; being numerous replaces multiplying.
“Though” replaces and; their children replaces their sons.
“They” replaces the singular he who passes through and strikes; Nile names the river.
